create_binary_ufuncs: create binary ufuncs (add, subtract, multiply) with numpy-compatible signatures and type casting
create_unary_ufuncs: create unary ufuncs (sin, cos, exp, log) with automatic int-to-float casting for float-returning functions
run_matmul_ufunc: run matrix multiplication with numpy-compatible casting, dtype promotion, and out-array support
run_ldexp_ufunc: run ldexp with special casting rules ensuring second arg is integer and float16 input preserves dtype
run_divmod_ufunc: run divmod returning quotient and remainder pairs with dual out-array support and validation
